args.title: Summary: Tamarack warehouse automation posts (2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse and its companion piece (https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion):

- Autonomous carts drove an 18% increase in warehouse pick rates in 2026.
- Implementation was slower than expected: integration took twice as long as planned.
- Per the companion piece, the biggest cost saving came from fewer mis-picks rather than raw speed gains.
